items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Higgenbotham was in the band, and he played the trombone solo -- and I did the singing.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've heard it. It's nice. Maybe they didn't put your name on it... Usually they put the vocalist's name on it.

No, they didn't put my name in nowhere. Higgenbotham was in the band, and he played the trombone solo -- and I did the singing. But it was a good chance to be on the thing, you know... All I wanted to do... I wanted to play, really.
